title: Air Fryer Fried Chicken Drumsticks
description: Crispy bran-flake-crusted chicken drumsticks with a fraction of the oil of deep frying — juicy inside, golden outside.
steps: Mix the crushed bran flakes with the remaining spices.
Brush chicken with mayo, coat in the bran mix, then air fry at 370F for 22-24 minutes, turning halfway.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste air fryer fried chicken

notes: Dark meat has more iron than white meat, and bran flakes add roughly 4g of fiber per serving.
